 Ashita Kashyap Published: Oct 23, 2026, 09:54 IST Updated: Oct 23, 2026, 09:54 IST School holiday in UP for MLC elections Schools in Uttar Pradesh are observing a holiday today on October 23, 2026, due to the Legislative to remain closed affected by the decision. The holiday covers government and recognised private schools, including CBSE and ICSE-affiliated institutions, according to reports.
 Parents and students should check their respective schools for confirmation of the closure.
 UP School holiday today: Are schools in Noida and Ghaziabad closed?
 Schools in Noida and Ghaziabad are expected to remain closed on Friday, October 23, 2026, due to the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council (MLC) elections. The polling is for the Meerut Division Graduate and Teacher constituencies. According to a reports, the holiday applies to schools from pre-primary to Class 12, as well as colleges and other educational institutions in the affected districts.
 In Ghaziabad, a district-level order has reportedly announced a special holiday for government, government-aided and recognised private schools. The order also covers schools affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE/ICSE) and other boards. Colleges and higher educational institutions are also included, according to reports by renowned media houses. 
 However, reports about Noida have differed on whether the entire district will observe a school holiday or whether the relief is limited to eligible voters. Parents should first confirm the latest instructions issued by their child's school before making plans.
 Why are schools closed in Uttar Pradesh on October 23?
 The holiday is linked to the biennial elections for the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council, also known as MLC elections. Voting is taking place for graduate and teacher constituencies, including those in the Meerut Division.
 The administration has made arrangements for polling across several districts. Educational institutions may be closed to support election led arrangements and ensure that eligible voters can exercise their voting rights.
 According to reports, polling is scheduled from 8 am to 4 pm . The election covers 11 Legislative Council seats, with polling taking place across multiple districts of Uttar Pradesh.
 Which schools and colleges will remain closed?
 According to reports the following educational institutions will be closed including:
 Government schools
 Government-aided schools
 Recognised private schools
 CBSE-affiliated schools
 ICSE-affiliated schools
 Schools affiliated with other recognised boards
 Colleges and higher educational institutions covered by the relevant district orders
 The reported closure includes students from pre-primary classes to Class 12. 
 However, the exact scope of the holiday depends on the order issued by the concerned district administration.
 Will schools reopen on October 24?
 The reported holiday is on October 23 which is Friday for the polling day, However, there is no confirmed information in the sources reviewed indicating that the closure will continue beyond that date.
 Since October 24 falls on a Saturday, the next school day may depend on the institution's regular weekend schedule. 
 Parents should check school notices, official messages or the school's website for confirmation of the next working day.
 What should parents and students know?
 Parents should check their school's official announcement or notifications before sending children to school. Students should also confirm whether any examinations, practicals, assignments or online classes have been rescheduled.
 The key point is that the October 23 holiday is connected to the MLC elections, but the exact rules may differ between districts. A school-specific confirmation is particularly important for families in Noida because reports have described the local arrangements differently.
